headline: NYM @ CIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 4.17 at CIN 4.53, with a projected total of 8.70. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: NYM moved -0.45 runs while CIN moved +0.83, changing the projected margin by -1.28 runs. The projected total climbed +0.44, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -11.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Bo Bichette, Blake Dunn, JJ Bleday, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Spencer Steer, Jared Young because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
